description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to media key capabilities within the Rialto client component. It includes a factory class for creating media key capability instances and a class representing the capabilities, including methods to query supported key systems and their versions.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing instances of IMediaKeysCapabilities, including singleton management and thread safety.

classes.name: firebolt::rialto::client::MediaKeysCapabilities
classes.description: Implementation of IMediaKeysCapabilities that provides information about supported media key systems and their versions.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesFactory::getMediaKeysCapabilities
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the singleton IMediaKeysCapabilities instance.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilities::getSupportedKeySystems
methods.description: Returns a list of supported key system identifiers.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilities::supportsKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if a specific key system is supported.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilities::getSupportedKeySystemVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version of a supported key system.
